dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Protocol and DSH Compatibility Layer：Mobile clients use this project's `dsh-mobile-v1`, not DSH's internal Remote protocol. A separate Host Adapter connects to the DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 Remote Gateway. Namespaces such as Session, Workspace, Settings, Commands, Goals, Schedule, Permission Presets, and Plugin Manager, together with their strict parameters, are confined to that adapter. See the [RC2 plugin management integration plan](docs/dsh-0.2.0-rc.2-plugin-management-mobile-integration.md) for request frames and mobile UI design.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Protocol and DSH Compatibility Layer：DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 requires `peer` on every Remote call. The gateway creates a local-user Peer with `ctx.connection.createPeer()` and disposes of it with the plugin. The Host Adapter injects it into regular requests, initial reads, and live subscriptions; mobile clients cannot choose the caller identity. Questions and approvals still use the gateway's Host listeners. Older gateways that omit it fail with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'signal')`. After upgrading DSH, reinstall this source version and restart `dsh web`; the phone protocol needs no change.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Protocol and DSH Compatibility Layer：Verify this contract against a locally installed official DSH (real Gateway/Connection, test business services, no user sessions read or written):

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Protocol and DSH Compatibility Layer：Pairing authentication and `dsh-mobile-v1` / `hello.protocol = 3` are unchanged. Live tokens no longer consume persistent event `seq` values: explicitly subscribe with `assistantStream: true` to receive an atomic `session-snapshot` and separate deltas. Regular `event` frames contain only persistent events. Clients without the new subscription receive persistent messages only.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Protocol and DSH Compatibility Layer：History responses include `historyFormatVersion` and `cursor`. Clear history caches and install a fresh baseline when the format changes. Pagination with `beforeSeq` or a fork with `atSeq` must also send `historyFormatVersion: 4`.
See the [rc.2 mobile integration guide](docs/dsh-rc2-mobile-integration.md) for current integration and acceptance checks, and the [Remote Gateway refactoring plan](docs/remote-gateway-refactor-plan.md) for earlier migration records.

Reconnecting the control channel or connecting a new device restores the outline baseline; if the Host has no outline, fall back to loaded turns. dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Protocol and DSH Compatibility Layer：The current source adds `file-upload-v1`: paired clients upload PDFs, Office files, archives, audio, and other files in chunks over the control connection. dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Protocol and DSH Compatibility Layer：The current source adds `agent-team-v1` and `subagent-conversations-v1`: member/shared-board queries, nested subagent directories, live team projections and member status, independent subagent history/subscriptions, continued conversations, and stop actions. dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Multi-Gateway Phase One (Current Source)：Mode precedence: **saved UI selection > `gatewayMode` > legacy `gatewayEnabled`**. Without a saved selection, legacy `gatewayEnabled: true` means Persistent; false means Off.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Multi-Gateway Phase One (Current Source)：- Off: disconnects mobile devices immediately and stays off after restart.
- Temporary: switches off and saves Off if no device connects successfully within 5 minutes by default. After a successful connection it stays on for that run. Restarting in Temporary mode restarts the wait. `gatewayWaitTimeoutMs` allows 30 seconds to 30 minutes.
- Persistent: no idle waiting timer. Pairing codes still expire after 5 minutes by default; file-transfer timeouts and other independent rules are unchanged.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Multi-Gateway Phase One (Current Source)：State defaults to `<deviceFile>.gateway.json`, usually `~/.dsh/mobile-gateway-devices.json.gateway.json`, or a configured `gatewayStateFile`. It holds a random UUID v4 identity and user selections, has mode `0600`, and is atomically replaced using a temporary file in the same directory. Corruption fails startup rather than silently generating a new identity. Each running instance needs separate device registry and state files.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Multi-Gateway Phase One (Current Source)：Keep both files when upgrading or migrating machines. For a new independent gateway clone, do not copy the original identity/state or device registry; generate a new identity and pair again. Do not delete identity files while running to reset modes. To reuse startup configuration, stop the instance, back up state, change only `mode` to `null`, retain `version` and `gatewayId`, then restart.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Multi-Gateway Phase One (Current Source)：`gatewayName` allows up to 80 characters and defaults to the hostname. `endpoints` supplies up to 16 additional candidates, each at most 2048 characters; pairing also merges preferred, public, and listening LAN addresses and rejects totals above 16. All addresses must reach the same gateway; do not use `0.0.0.0` / `::`. They must be reachable from the phone; use WSS publicly.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Install the Plugin：Requires Node.js 22 or newer. The RTC library is a required runtime dependency installed automatically with the plugin; no separate dependency installation is needed.

Prerequisites: `dsh` CLI and `pnpm` installed, with `dsh web` working. Run `pnpm --version` to ensure the current user can find `pnpm`.

For LAN use, install the plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway@latest
```

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Install the Plugin：For public-IP access on a Linux server, use the unified initializer. It installs/updates the plugin and requests sudo once to install the system Helper:

```bash
npx --yes dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway@latest init
```

`init` installs the exact version of the executing npm package into the DSH profile and skips pnpm's new-release waiting period for that version only, keeping plugin and Helper versions aligned.

After installation, stop and restart WebUI:

```bash
dsh web
```
dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Install the Plugin：Open WebUI and confirm Mobile Devices appears at the bottom of the left sidebar.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · LAN Pairing：1. Open Mobile Devices in WebUI.
2. Set Gateway Mode to Persistent, or Temporary for short pairing sessions.
3. Leave Device Authentication enabled.
4. First use defaults to Direct LAN. Verify `ws://<电脑局域网 IP>:3081/ws/mobile`. For guidance, open Connection & Pairing → Help me choose a connection, then select the phone’s network, host type and Tailscale setup. Review the recommendation and prerequisites; settings are saved only when you choose Use this recommendation. The guide stays collapsed until clicked. Manual connection settings and the pairing address remain visible, including the option to select P2P. Cloudflare Tunnel can remain enabled.
5. Enter a device name and select Generate Pairing QR Code.
6. Open device authentication in the mobile client and scan the QR code.
7. Pairing is complete when the trusted device shows Online in WebUI.
dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · LAN Pairing：If a firewall blocks the connection, allow TCP `3081` only on private networks. Do not expose 3081 publicly.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Public-IP Pairing on Linux Servers：> [!NOTE]
> Public-IP pairing here specifically means Linux servers. The one-command setup is available since `v0.6.4` for Ubuntu/Debian with a fixed public IPv4. Node.js, `pnpm`, and the `dsh` CLI must already be installed. CentOS is not currently supported.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 1. Prepare Public Ports：Copy the public IPv4 from your cloud console and allow inbound TCP `80` and `443` in its security group. Do not expose the DSH WebUI port or TCP `3081` publicly.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 2. Initialize：First confirm the regular DSH user can run `pnpm`:

```bash
pnpm --version
```

Then run as that same regular user, not `root` or `sudo npx`:

```bash
npm_config_registry=https://registry.npmjs.org \
npx --yes dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway@latest init
```

This installs/updates the plugin and requests sudo once for Nginx, Certbot, the system Helper, and certificate renewal timers. `init` aligns the exact DSH-profile and Helper versions.

Start or restart WebUI afterward:

```bash
dsh web
```

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 3. Open Remote WebUI：Prefer the built-in port forwarding in VS Code, Cursor, or similar IDEs. Alternatively, run on your own computer:

```bash
ssh -N -L <本地端口>:127.0.0.1:<DSH 实际端口> <服务器用户名>@<服务器公网 IP>
```

Then open in your local browser:

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 4. Configure the Public Endpoint：Open Mobile Devices, enter the cloud console's public IPv4 in Public Access, and choose Configure Public Access or Update Public Configuration. The Helper detects the current `dsh web` port and configures Nginx, TLS certificates, and `wss://<公网 IP>/ws/mobile`.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 5. Pair the Mobile Device：1. Enable Allow Mobile Connections and leave Device Authentication enabled.
2. Enter a device name and generate a pairing QR code.
3. Open device authentication on the phone and scan the QR code.
4. Pairing is complete when the device shows Online in WebUI.

QR codes are single-use and expire after 5 minutes. Generate a new one in WebUI if needed.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Remote Access to Home Windows / macOS Computers：Home computers usually lack a fixed public IP; router port forwarding is not recommended here. The Windows/macOS panel offers account/domain-free Quick Tunnels and fixed-domain named Tunnels. On first use, the plugin downloads and verifies official Cloudflare `cloudflared` into the current user's cache. No manual system service installation is required.

Start `dsh web` first. The computer must stay awake, online, and running DSH; sleep or process exit interrupts remote access.

text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel (Temporary Access)：New installations default to LAN direct on the same Wi-Fi. If the LAN entry is unavailable, the panel waits for a LAN address instead of silently selecting a public entry. P2P is an explicit opt-in. P2P still needs a reachable entry for pairing and negotiation. Cloudflare STUN discovers public addresses and ports automatically by default. Override the pairing address and STUN servers in the UI if needed; failed direct connections fall back to WebSocket at that entry. Choices, addresses and STUN settings persist and apply to new connections, preserving existing connections and explicit disabled startup settings. For remote access, change Pairing Connection Method under Mobile Devices → Connection & Pairing to Automatic · Prefer Public or Cloudflare Public. A pink setup hint appears if the public route is not ready. Under Cloudflare Tunnel choose Quick Tunnel · No Domain and enable it. First use downloads `cloudflared`; once connected, the generated `wss://<名称>.trycloudflare.com/ws/mobile` becomes the pairing address. For LAN use, select Automatic · Prefer LAN or Direct LAN; the Tunnel may stay on. Generate

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel (Temporary Access)：Quick Tunnel needs no Cloudflare account, Token, or domain, but its address may change after DSH restarts or tunnel reconnection. The app trusts only confirmed addresses: generate a new QR code and scan again after changes. **An online computer does not guarantee the old URL still works.** Cloudflare positions Quick Tunnel for testing/development, with concurrency limits and no availability guarantee. See the [Quick Tunnel documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/networks/connectors/cloudflare-tunnel/do-more-with-tunnels/trycloudflare/).

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel (Temporary Access)：Update Tunnel Configuration saves the mode and named-Tunnel parameters; unchanged settings do not reconnect. Restart Tunnel interrupts mobile connections and recreates the Cloudflare tunnel without restarting DSH Web. Quick mode may obtain a new address, clearing the old QR code; scan again with the new URL. This does not upgrade `cloudflared` automatically.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Named Tunnel (Fixed Address)：1. [Create a remotely managed Tunnel](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tunnel/get-started/) in Cloudflare, add a public hostname such as `gateway.example.com`, and set **Service URL** to `http://127.0.0.1:3082`. No Cloudflare system service or inbound router port is required.
2. Copy the Token from Add a replica, select Named Tunnel · Fixed Domain under Mobile Devices → Cloudflare Tunnel, enter the hostname/Token, and enable it. The plugin selects Persistent mode and starts the dedicated local listener and `cloudflared`. After tunnel registration it separately checks local DNS, TLS, and the public gateway route. On success, use the supplied `wss://gateway.example.com/ws/mobile` to generate a QR code.
3. Starting `dsh web` restores enabled Tunnels automatically. Closing Cloudflare Tunnel in the panel stops the managed `cloudflared` and dedicated listener. Manually disabling the gateway pauses the Tunnel; enabling it resumes it.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Named Tunnel (Fixed Address)：Both Cloudflare routes accept only `/ws/mobile` WebSocket. Other HTTP paths, including DSH WebUI and `/mgw`, return 404. Device credentials are always required, even if local Debug authentication is disabled. Named-Tunnel Tokens are stored in `<deviceFile>.cloudflare.json` (default `~/.dsh/mobile-gateway-devices.json.cloudflare.json`) with mode `0600` and never returned to the browser. The default private `cloudflared-bin` cache does not use system/other-app binaries. Every start verifies the cached file; only a missing/corrupt cache triggers a fixed-version download with SHA-256 checked against official assets. An external binary is used only with explicit `cloudflaredPath`. If `cloudflarePort` changes, update the named-Tunnel Service URL port too. The cached `cloudflared` is checked at every start.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Endpoint Checks and Status：`state: online` means only that cloudflared registered a tunnel connection, not that the public hostname, TLS, or origin route works. Status also includes `endpointHealth` (state, hint, check time, error code) and `publicReady`. The panel checks once after connecting; Check Public DNS / TLS / WebSocket retries via the management-authenticated `POST /mgw/cloudflare/check` without restarting the Tunnel.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Endpoint Checks and Status：Checks use system DNS and HTTPS WebSocket requests with strict certificate verification, no pairing/device tokens, and no redirects. Only HTTP 401 with the gateway echoing the fresh random probe marker proves the authenticated route is reachable; generic proxy/Cloudflare Access 401 responses do not count. The marker appears only in rejections without valid device credentials and grants no access. This is a local network snapshot, not proof of phone connectivity, authentication, or session sync.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Endpoint Checks and Status：Local DNS failure does not prove a public record is absent: new records may encounter cached NXDOMAIN, local DNS, VPN, or proxy issues. Check the public hostname and proxied CNAME, then retry later; do not disable TLS verification. The plugin runs remotely managed Tunnels using a Tunnel Token, which does not create DNS or hostname routes. Separately authorized cloudflared CLI/API operations can create them, but are outside this check.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Direct access from an embedded Tailscale node：Select the dedicated Tailscale private network option under Connection & Pairing → Connection plan. The gateway checks this host’s visible Tailscale interfaces and builds an entry using the actual LAN listener port and path. This is the gateway host’s IP, not the phone’s, and does not prove login state or phone reachability. Switching never retains a Cloudflare address. If detection fails, copy the host IP from Tailscale or run `tailscale ip -4` on the host. Enter that IP or a full `ws://` URL, save the Tailscale address, then generate a QR code. Drafts survive polling, saved choices survive restart, and Tailscale QR codes include only Tailscale IP entries.

text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Direct access from an embedded Tailscale node：An app with embedded Tailscale support can use `ws://100.100.10.20:3081/ws/mobile`, replacing the IP with the host's Tailscale IPv4. Join the app node and host to the same tailnet, allow the TCP port in access rules and the host firewall, and bind the gateway LAN listener to a reachable interface (such as `0.0.0.0`) rather than loopback only. Enter this address in WebUI and generate a new pairing code. The IP can also be set explicitly with `lanAdvertiseHost`.

text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Direct access from an embedded Tailscale node：Endpoint validation and LAN source checks accept `100.64.0.0/10`, IPv4-mapped sources and existing private IPv6 addresses. Device authentication remains mandatory; the LAN listener does not expose WebUI or management APIs. Forwarded headers are not trusted. Other `100.*` addresses and plaintext `.ts.net` hostnames are not automatically allowed. This route does not require Tailscale Serve; the Serve instructions below apply to devices using the system Tailscale client.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Multi-Gateway Phase One (Current Source)：Mode precedence: **saved UI selection > `gatewayMode` > legacy `gatewayEnabled`**. Without a saved selection, legacy `gatewayEnabled: true` means Persistent; false means Off.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Multi-Gateway Phase One (Current Source)：- Off: disconnects mobile devices immediately and stays off after restart.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Multi-Gateway Phase One (Current Source)：Keep both files when upgrading or migrating machines. text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel (Temporary Access)：The default is Automatic · Prefer LAN. For remote access, change Pairing Connection Method under Mobile Devices → Connection & Pairing to Automatic · Prefer Public or Cloudflare Public. A pink setup hint appears if the public route is not ready. Under Cloudflare Tunnel choose Quick Tunnel · No Domain and enable it. First use downloads `cloudflared`; once connected, the generated `wss://<名称>.trycloudflare.com/ws/mobile` becomes the pairing address. dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel (Temporary Access)：Quick Tunnel needs no Cloudflare account, Token, or domain, but its address may change after DSH restarts or tunnel reconnection. The app trusts only confirmed addresses: generate a new QR code and scan again after changes. **An online computer does not guarantee the old URL still works.** Cloudflare positions Quick Tunnel for testing/development, with concurrency limits and no availability guarantee. See the [Quick Tunnel documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/networks/connectors/cloudflare-tunnel/do-more-with-tunnels/trycloudflare/).

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel (Temporary Access)：Update Tunnel Configuration saves the mode and named-Tunnel parameters; unchanged settings do not reconnect. Restart Tunnel interrupts mobile connections and recreates the Cloudflare tunnel without restarting DSH Web. Quick mode may obtain a new address, clearing the old QR code; scan again with the new URL. This does not upgrade `cloudflared` automatically.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Named Tunnel (Fixed Address)：1. [Create a remotely managed Tunnel](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tunnel/get-started/) in Cloudflare, add a public hostname such as `gateway.example.com`, and set **Service URL** to `http://127.0.0.1:3082`. No Cloudflare system service or inbound router port is required.
2. Copy the Token from Add a replica, select Named Tunnel · Fixed Domain under Mobile Devices → Cloudflare Tunnel, enter the hostname/Token, and enable it. The plugin selects Persistent mode and starts the dedicated local listener and `cloudflared`. After tunnel registration it separately checks local DNS, TLS, and the public gateway route. On success, use the supplied `wss://gateway.example.com/ws/mobile` to generate a QR code.
3. Starting `dsh web` restores enabled Tunnels automatically. Closing Cloudflare Tunnel in the panel stops the managed `cloudflared` and dedicated listener. Manually disabling the gateway pauses the Tunnel; enabling it resumes it.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Named Tunnel (Fixed Address)：Both Cloudflare routes accept only `/ws/mobile` WebSocket. Other HTTP paths, including DSH WebUI and `/mgw`, return 404. Device credentials are always required, even if local Debug authentication is disabled. Named-Tunnel Tokens are stored in `<deviceFile>.cloudflare.json` (default `~/.dsh/mobile-gateway-devices.json.cloudflare.json`) with mode `0600` and never returned to the browser. The default private `cloudflared-bin` cache does not use system/other-app binaries. Every start verifies the cached file; only a missing/corrupt cache triggers a fixed-version download with SHA-256 checked against official assets. An external binary is used only with explicit `cloudflaredPath`. If `cloudflarePort` changes, update the named-Tunnel Service URL port too. The cached `cloudflared` is checked at every start.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Endpoint Checks and Status：`state: online` means only that cloudflared registered a tunnel connection, not that the public hostname, TLS, or origin route works. Status also includes `endpointHealth` (state, hint, check time, error code) and `publicReady`. The panel checks once after connecting; Check Public DNS / TLS / WebSocket retries via the management-authenticated `POST /mgw/cloudflare/check` without restarting the Tunnel.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Endpoint Checks and Status：Checks use system DNS and HTTPS WebSocket requests with strict certificate verification, no pairing/device tokens, and no redirects. Only HTTP 401 with the gateway echoing the fresh random probe marker proves the authenticated route is reachable; generic proxy/Cloudflare Access 401 responses do not count. The marker appears only in rejections without valid device credentials and grants no access. This is a local network snapshot, not proof of phone connectivity, authentication, or session sync.

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Endpoint Checks and Status：Local DNS failure does not prove a public record is absent: new records may encounter cached NXDOMAIN, local DNS, VPN, or proxy issues. Check the public hostname and proxied CNAME, then retry later; do not disable TLS verification. The plugin runs remotely managed Tunnels using a Tunnel Token, which does not create DNS or hostname routes. Separately authorized cloudflared CLI/API operations can create them, but are outside this check.

text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel（一键临时接入）：首次使用默认选择「局域网直连」，使用同一 Wi-Fi 下的主机内网地址；局域网入口不可用时会提示等待地址，不自动切换到公网。需要 P2P 时，可主动选择「公网入口 + 优先 P2P（实验）」。P2P 仍需可达地址完成配对和协商，默认使用 Cloudflare STUN 自动发现公网地址与端口，无需手填；可在界面覆盖配对地址及 STUN 服务；无法直连时回退该地址的 WebSocket。选择、地址和 STUN 设置均会保存，新连接生效，已有连接保留；显式关闭的配置仍受尊重。需要外网连接时，在「移动设备 → 连接与配对」将「配对连接方式」改为「自动选择 · 优先外网」或「Cloudflare 外网」；外网入口尚未就绪时，配对区域下方会显示粉红色配置引导。在下方 Cloudflare Tunnel 配置中选择「Quick Tunnel · 无需域名」，点击「一键开启 Quick Tunnel」。面板会在首次运行时下载 `cloudflared`，连接后显示随机的 `wss://<名称>.trycloudflare.com/ws/mobile`，并自动将其填为配对地址。需要在局域网内直连时，将“配对连接方式”改回“自动选择 · 优先内网直连”或“局域网直连”；Tunnel 可以继续开启。生成二维码，用手机 App 扫码即可。关闭开关会停止隧道；DSH 再次启动时会恢复已开启的 Quick 模式并取得**新的随机地址**。

text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel（一键临时接入）：Quick Tunnel 无需 Cloudflare 账户、Token 或自己的公网域名，但地址在 DSH 重启或隧道重连后可能变化。手机 App 只信任已确认的地址，因此地址变化后需在面板重新生成二维码并扫码更新配对；**仅凭 PC 在线不能保证旧地址继续可用**。Cloudflare 将 Quick Tunnel 定位于测试和开发，当前有并发请求上限且不提供可用性保证。参见 [Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 文档](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/networks/connectors/cloudflare-tunnel/do-more-with-tunnels/trycloudflare/)。

text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare Quick Tunnel（一键临时接入）：面板中的“更新 Tunnel 配置”保存所选模式及命名 Tunnel 参数；配置不变时不会重新连接。“重启 Tunnel”会断开当前移动连接并重建 Cloudflare 隧道，不会重启 DSH Web；Quick Tunnel 重启后可能取得新地址，旧二维码会清除，需按新地址重新扫码。此操作不会自动升级 `cloudflared` 到最新版本。

text:
dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare 命名 Tunnel（固定地址）：1. 在 [Cloudflare 控制台创建远程管理的 Tunnel](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tunnel/get-started/)，添加一个公开域名（例如 `gateway.example.com`），将该路由的 **Service URL** 设为 `http://127.0.0.1:3082`。无需安装 Cloudflare 系统服务，也无需开放路由器入站端口。
2. 从 Tunnel 的「Add a replica」安装命令中复制 Token，在 DSH「移动设备 → Cloudflare Tunnel」选择「命名 Tunnel · 固定域名」，输入公开域名和 Token 后开启。插件会将网关设为常驻模式，启动本机专用入口和 `cloudflared`。隧道传输连接后，面板会独立检测本机到公网入口的 DNS、TLS 和移动网关路由；检测通过后使用自动填入的 `wss://gateway.example.com/ws/mobile` 生成配对二维码。
3. 以后启动 `dsh web` 会自动恢复已开启的 Tunnel；在面板点击「关闭 Cloudflare Tunnel」会停止插件管理的 `cloudflared` 并关闭本机专用入口。若手动关闭网关，Tunnel 会暂停，重新开启网关后恢复。
section: Cloudflare 命名 Tunnel（固定地址）

text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Cloudflare 命名 Tunnel（固定地址）：两种 Cloudflare 入口都只接受 `/ws/mobile` WebSocket，其他 HTTP 路径（包括 DSH WebUI 和 `/mgw` 管理接口）返回 404；设备凭证始终必需，即使本机 Debug 鉴权被关闭也一样。命名 Tunnel 的 Token 保存在 `<deviceFile>.cloudflare.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/mobile-gateway-devices.json.cloudflare.json`），权限为 `0600`，不会返回给浏览器。默认使用 DSH 私有的 `cloudflared-bin` 缓存，不读取系统或其他 App 的 `cloudflared`；每次启动 Tunnel 都校验缓存文件，只有缓存缺失或损坏时才下载固定版本并核对 Cloudflare 官方发布资产的 SHA-256。仅在显式配置 `cloudflaredPath` 时使用外部程序。使用自定义 `cloudflarePort` 时，命名 Tunnel 路由的 Service URL 端口也要相应修改。
section: Cloudflare 命名 Tunnel（固定地址）

text:
dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 公网入口检测与状态含义：`state: online` 只表示 cloudflared 已注册隧道连接，不保证公开域名、TLS 或源站路由可用。状态 API 另外提供 `endpointHealth`（状态、提示、检测时间及错误码）和 `publicReady`。面板在连接后自动检测一次，也可点击「检测公网 DNS / TLS / WebSocket」重试；该按钮调用受现有管理鉴权保护的 `POST /mgw/cloudflare/check`，不会重启隧道。

检测使用本机系统 DNS 和严格证书校验的 HTTPS WebSocket 请求，不携带配对码或设备 Token，不跟随重定向。只有 HTTP 401 且移动网关回显本次随机探测标记时，才确认受鉴权保护的网关路由可达；代理或 Cloudflare Access 的普通 401 不会被当作成功。该标记只在缺少有效设备凭证的拒绝响应中回显，不授予任何访问权限。结果是一次本机网络快照，不保证手机网络、设备鉴权或会话同步成功。
section: 公网入口检测与状态含义

text: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 公网入口检测与状态含义：本机解析失败不代表公共 DNS 记录必然不存在：刚创建记录时可能仍有 NXDOMAIN 缓存，也可能受本机 DNS、VPN 或代理影响。核对公开主机名和已代理 CNAME，再稍后重试，不要关闭 TLS 校验。插件目前使用 Tunnel Token 运行远程管理的隧道，该 Token 不会自动创建域名路由或 DNS；具备额外账户授权的 cloudflared CLI / Cloudflare API 可以配置这些资源，但不属于本检测功能。
section: 公网入口检测与状态含义

text:
dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · App 内嵌 Tailscale 节点直连：在“连接与配对 → 连接方案”选择独立的“Tailscale 私有网络”。网关会检测当前进程所在主机的 Tailscale 网卡，读取可用私有 IP 并拼接实际局域网监听端口及路径；这不是手机的 IP，也不代表已经验证登录状态或手机可达性。切换方案不会保留 Cloudflare 地址。检测不到时，可复制主机 Tailscale 应用中的 IP，或在主机运行 `tailscale ip -4`，直接填写 IP 或完整 `ws://` 地址，点击“保存 Tailscale 地址”后生成二维码。填写中的内容不会被轮询刷新覆盖，选择及地址会跨重启保存；该方案的二维码仅包含 Tailscale IP 入口。

自动检测不执行 Tailscale 登录或配置命令，也不修改网关监听地址。仅支持当前网络命名空间中可见的 Tailscale 网卡；容器、用户态代理等模式可能无法自动检测或直接访问，需手动确认入口和端口可从 tailnet 访问。
section: App 内嵌 Tailscale 节点直连

text:
dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · App 内嵌 Tailscale 节点直连：支持内嵌 Tailscale 的 App 可使用 `ws://100.100.10.20:3081/ws/mobile`（替换成主机的 Tailscale IPv4）。App 节点和主机需加入同一 tailnet，访问规则及主机防火墙需允许对应 TCP 端口，网关 LAN 监听器需绑定可达的接口（例如 `0.0.0.0`），而不是仅绑定回环。WebUI 中填写该地址后重新生成配对码；如使用 `lanAdvertiseHost`，也可显式填写这个 IP。

地址校验和 LAN 来源检查支持 `100.64.0.0/10`、IPv4 映射来源及原有私网 IPv6。仍强制设备鉴权，LAN 入口不提供 WebUI 或管理 API；不会信任 `X-Forwarded-For`，也不会允许整个 `100.*` 地址段或按 `.ts.net` 域名后缀放宽明文校验。此方式不需要 Tailscale Serve；下面的 Serve 方案适用于使用系统 Tailscale 客户端的场景。

text:
dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · Tailscale（推荐长期使用）：1. 在电脑和手机安装 [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/download)，并登录同一个 Tailnet。
2. 在 Windows PowerShell 或 macOS 终端执行：

```bash
tailscale serve --bg 3081
```

3. 执行 `tailscale serve status` 查看生成的 `https://<设备名>.<tailnet>.ts.net` 地址。
4. 将地址改为 `wss://<设备名>.<tailnet>.ts.net/ws/mobile`，填入 WebUI 的“WebSocket 地址”，再生成二维码配对。

Tailscale Serve 只允许同一 Tailnet 中符合访问规则的设备连接，并自动提供 HTTPS。可用 `tailscale serve reset` 停止转发。参见 [Tailscale Serve 文档](https://tailscale.com/docs/reference/tailscale-cli/serve)。

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 网关配置方式总览：| 使用场景 | 推荐入口 | 移动端 WebSocket 地址 | 需要的额外配置 | 端口与鉴权 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 同一局域网 | 插件局域网入口 | `ws://<电脑局域网 IP>:3081/ws/mobile` | 无需 Helper 或 Nginx；电脑与手机 位于可互访的局域网 | 仅对私有网络放行 TCP `3081`；保持鉴权开启 |
| 本机 iOS 模拟器 | DSH WebUI 本地入口 | `ws://127.0.0.1:<DSH WebUI 端口>/ws/mobile` | 无需 Helper、Nginx 或独立的 `3081` 端口 | 不开放任何外部端口；仅 Debug 时可关闭鉴权 |
| Linux 公网服务器 | 插件 Helper + Nginx + TLS | `wss://<服务器公网 IPv4>/ws/mobile` | 执行 `init`，再从 WebUI 填写公网 IPv4 | 云安全组放行 TCP `80/443`；不要公开 DSH 端口和 `3081`；必须鉴权 |
| 家用 Windows / macOS | Cloudflare 命名 Tunnel | `wss://<公开域名>/ws/mobile` | 在 Cloudflare 建立公开域名到 `127.0.0.1:3082` 的路由；面板填写域名与 Token 并开启 | 无需路由器端口转发；独立入口强制设备鉴权 |
| 家用 Windows / macOS | Cloudflare Quick Tunnel | `wss://<随机名称>.trycloudflare.com/ws/mobile` | 面板一键开启；重启或重连后地址变化需重新扫码 | 无需域名、账户或端口转发；独立入口强制设备鉴权 |
| 家用 Windows / macOS | Tailscale Serve | `wss://<Tailscale 域名>/ws/mobile` | 手动转发到 `127.0.0.1:3081`，将生成的地址填入 WebUI | 无需路由器端口转发；保持鉴权开启 |

|---|---|
| WebUI 没有“移动设备” | 确认安装在 `web` profile，并完整重启 `dsh web` |
| 移动端 收到 `503` | 回到 WebUI 开启“允许移动设备连接” |
| 移动端 收到 `401` | 在 WebUI 重新生成二维码并配对 |

面板右上角“工具”菜单提供“重启当前网关”和“停止 DSH Web”。重启只在通过 `dsh web` 启动时可用，会结束当前 Web 进程并沿用原启动参数重新运行；重启时自动加入 `--no-open`，不会再打开新的浏览器标签页，当前标签页会等待恢复并刷新。重启后的进程在后台运行，不再由原 Terminal 前台任务管理；需要关闭时可在同一菜单点击“停止 DSH Web”，或在 Terminal 找到监听 Web 端口的 DSH 进程并发送 `SIGTERM`。重启期间连接会短暂中断，Quick Tunnel 的外网地址可能随之改变。源码修改后需重新安装插件并重启 `dsh web`。

dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway README · 官方语音输入：网关已接入 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 官方实验性语音输入插件。移动端可以查询识别器、订阅模型准备进度、准备模型、设置识别偏好，以及提交录音取得文字。取消和断线会中止转写，结果不会自动发送给 Agent。

1. 在 DSH 插件管理中启用“语音输入”（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`），下载并准备模型。
2. 客户端通过已配对的 control WebSocket 查询 `speech-catalog`，确认插件可用及模型 `ready`/`standby`。
3. 长按录音、松手后，将完整音频转换为 16 kHz 单声道 PCM16 WAV，通过 `speech-transcribe` 上传 Base64。
4. 收到 `speech-transcript` 后将文字填入输入框，用户确认后使用现有 `message` 发送。
